relationships.subject: L5 spinal nerve transection neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: The ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn of L5-SNT mice showed increased TPR mRNA expression.

key_findings: Intrathecal TPR agonist I-BOP reduced PGE2-induced allodynia, neuropathic allodynia and formalin second-phase behavior.
TPR mRNA increased in ipsilateral dorsal horn after L5-SNT; TPR localized to substantia gelatinosa and deep laminae.
